trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.text: The platinum unlocks only when the other 54 trophies are all earned.
Follow the roadmap: story first, then the counted activities and collectibles, then the clean-up.
It pops automatically the moment the 54th other trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum pops automatically when the last one unlocks.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.text: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from the start of the story.
Finish the mission's objectives to reach its end cutscene.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes; it cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission Gone Fishing; the trophy unlocks at its end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.text: Play through Chapter 1's missions in story order.
Complete the chapter's final mission to close the chapter.
The trophy unlocks when Chapter 1 ends; story progress is never missable.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1; the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes.

Complete the final mission to roll the credits.
This gold trophy unlocks when the final mission completes.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission; this gold trophy unlocks at the story's end.

Complete The Cartel Heist's objectives.

Complete Child's Play's objectives.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play.

steps.text: Play the story until the mission Headliners appears.
Complete Headliners' objectives.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners.

Complete VCIA Takedown's objectives.

Complete Operation Savage Glory's objectives.
The trophy unlocks when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: 100% completion counts story, side missions, activities and collectibles together.
Track the in-game completion percentage and clear each category in turn.
This gold trophy unlocks the moment completion reaches 100%.
Use the tracker's stepper to count the categories you have finished.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion across story, side content, activities and collectibles; this gold trophy unlocks at 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: Stunts are jumps, airtime, near-misses and other driving feats; PSN tracks the count to 250.
Chain stunts while driving around Leonida; each one adds to the count.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 250) to count as you go.
The trophy unlocks at 250 stunts.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts while driving; use the stepper to count them (0 / 250).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

steps.text: There are 9 activity types in Leonida; try each one once.
Activities include racing, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade games and more.
The trophy unlocks once all 9 types have been tried.

trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once; the trophy unlocks when the last type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps.text: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges; each must be gold-medalled.
Visit the shooting ranges across Leonida and attempt each challenge.
Replay any challenge until it scores gold; progress saves per challenge.
The trophy unlocks when all 42 challenges hold a gold medal.

trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges; replay any challenge until it scores gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

steps.text: Top Fun drone races run at 14 locations across Leonida.
Win a drone race at each location; a win at one location does not count for another.
The trophy unlocks once all 14 locations have a win.

trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.text: Win 20 different races; the same race won twice counts once.
Races include street, off-road and water events across Leonida.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 20) to count distinct wins.
The trophy unlocks at 20 different race wins.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; a repeat win of the same race does not count twice.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.text: Find Cal and take his fishing challenge.
Out-fish Cal in the challenge to beat him.
The trophy unlocks when you beat Cal.

trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.text: Find an arcade machine in Leonida and start a game.
Play the arcade game through to its end.
The trophy unlocks when one arcade game is completed.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

steps.text: Play Andy's mission strand to its final mission.
Complete Andy's final mission.
The trophy unlocks when Andy's strand ends.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

steps.text: Play Kenton's mission strand to its final mission.
Complete Kenton's final mission.
The trophy unlocks when Kenton's strand ends.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.

steps.text: Play Billy's mission strand to its final mission.
Complete Billy's final mission.
The trophy unlocks when Billy's strand ends.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

steps.text: Strangers across Leonida offer mission strands; 8 must be completed.
Each strand ends with its own final mission; finish all of a strand's missions.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 8) to count finished strands.
The trophy unlocks at 8 completed stranger strands.

trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida; use the stepper (0 / 8).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

steps.text: Play Randy's mission strand to its final mission.
Complete Randy's final mission.
The trophy unlocks when Randy's strand ends.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps.text: Play Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission.
Complete Tyrone's final mission.
The trophy unlocks when Tyrone's strand ends.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps.text: There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida; meditate at each one.
Meditation spots are marked in the world once found; visit all 18.
This is the one possibly missable trophy: a spot can be missed if its area becomes unavailable, so meditate at each spot as soon as you find it.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 18) to count the spots you have meditated at.
The trophy unlocks at 18 spots.

trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. MISSABLE: meditate at each spot as soon as you find it. Use the stepper (0 / 18).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps.text: Bret asks you to hunt a unique animal.
Track and hunt the unique animal Bret names.
The trophy unlocks when the hunt is done.

trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.text: Collectible cards are scattered across Leonida; a set is complete when all its cards are found.
Complete 3 full card sets.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 3) to count finished sets.
The trophy unlocks at 3 completed sets.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets; use the stepper (0 / 3).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.text: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida; PSN tracks the count to 100.
Each location counts once; revisit the map to find spots you have not used.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 100) to count the locations.
The trophy unlocks at 100 locations.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations; use the stepper (0 / 100).

trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.text: Challenges are the game's tracked feats; complete 50 of them.
Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and activities.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 50) to count completed challenges.
The trophy unlocks at 50 challenges.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges; use the stepper (0 / 50).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

steps.text: Reach a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you.
Lose the wanted level and escape the heat with your partner.
The trophy unlocks once you escape at 4 stars together.

trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.text: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner.
Do not lose your Wanted Level between the three robberies.
The trophy unlocks after the third shop in the chain.

trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.text: Discover 100 vehicles; each new vehicle type counts once.
Drive, steal and find vehicles across Leonida to discover new types.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 100) to count discovered vehicles.
The trophy unlocks at 100 discovered vehicles.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles; use the stepper (0 / 100).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.text: Enter Combat Focus with at least 5 enemies in range.
Take down 5 enemies before the single Combat Focus use ends.
The trophy unlocks when 5 fall in one use.

trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps.text: Go to VCIA, the Vice City airport.
Leave the airport in an unscheduled way — take a plane out without a scheduled flight.
The trophy unlocks when the unscheduled departure happens.

trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.text: Rhinos are the tanks; the trophy is about dealing with them.
Take on a Rhino tank and survive the encounter.
The trophy unlocks when the Rhino encounter is survived.

trophies.guide: Survive a Rhino tank encounter.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.text: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Rob the store without being detected at any point.
The trophy unlocks if you escape undetected.

trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.text: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape after each one.
Each vault robbery must end with a successful escape.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 5) to count escaped vaults.
The trophy unlocks at 5 escaped vault robberies.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape; use the stepper (0 / 5).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

steps.text: Find an Armored Truck on the road in Leonida.
Rob the truck, then escape.
The trophy unlocks when you escape after the robbery.

trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.text: Leonida has 52 areas; visit every one of them.
Drive, fly and walk through each area until it registers as explored.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 52) to count explored areas.
The trophy unlocks at 52 areas explored.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida; use the stepper (0 / 52).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

steps.text: There are 9 gangs in Leonida, each with an Illegal Operation.
Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 9) to count gangs hit.
The trophy unlocks once all 9 gangs have been robbed.

trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs; use the stepper (0 / 9).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps.text: The official description says: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
The exact trigger is UNCONFIRMED: no guide has yet pinned down which bar or spot counts.
Try the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail with the ocean view.
Marked unconfirmed in this guide until a source confirms the trigger.

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is not yet pinned down — try the beachfront bars.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

steps.text: Find a vehicle showroom in Leonida.
Smash your way out of the showroom in classic style — drive straight through the glass.
The trophy unlocks when you break out.

trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

steps.text: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a game and follow through at the alley.
The trophy unlocks when the bowling is done.

trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.

trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.text: The description points to a partnership moment with mass appeal.
Play through the partnership content until the moment lands.
The trophy unlocks at that partnership moment.

trophies.guide: Reach the partnership moment with mass appeal.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.text: PSN tracks a count to 500 for the choices this trophy counts.
Make choices across the game; each counted choice adds to the total.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 500) to count the choices.
The trophy unlocks at 500 counted choices.

trophies.guide: Make choices (PSN tracks a count to 500); use the stepper (0 / 500).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.text: The official description says: second time's the charm.
The exact trigger is UNCONFIRMED: PowerPyx notes it is currently unknown, believed related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.
The working guess: fail once at the Payday Loans store, then succeed on the second try.
Marked unconfirmed in this guide until a source confirms the trigger.

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: second time's the charm. Believed related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — fail once, succeed on the second try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.text: CONFIRMED: go to the road northwest of the Starlet Motel, Kelly County.
Go after 02:00, alone, in a car with its headlights flashing.
The spawn is somewhat random, so wait and repeat if nothing happens.
The trophy unlocks when the strange event happens.

trophies.guide: CONFIRMED: road NW of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 02:00, solo, headlights flashing. Spawn is somewhat random — wait and repeat.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

steps.text: CONFIRMED: ride a motorbike or bicycle in Vice City / Ocean Beach.
Kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds, as a melee drive-by.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 10) to count the pedestrians kicked.
The trophy unlocks at 10 kicks inside 60 seconds.

trophies.guide: CONFIRMED: motorbike/bicycle in Vice City / Ocean Beach, kick 10 pedestrians with Square in 60s. Use the stepper (0 / 10).

Earn $250,000 in total from laundering.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 250,000) to count laundered earnings.
The trophy unlocks at $250,000 laundered.

trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts; use the stepper (0 / 250,000).

Any shop purchase counts toward the total.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 100,000) to count spending.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops; use the stepper (0 / 100,000).

Purchase each garage property.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 8) to count bought garages.
The trophy unlocks when all 8 are bought.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties; use the stepper (0 / 8).

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.text: Register vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
Register 10 different vehicles.
Use the tracker's stepper (0 / 10) to count registered vehicles.
The trophy unlocks at 10 registered vehicles.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app; use the stepper (0 / 10).
